subject: Emotions
title: The Future of Disgust
description: Learn The Future of Disgust in one minute.

hook.text: Lab-grown meat bypasses animal slaughter. Will it also bypass the disgust of killing for food?

buildup.text: Technology keeps removing disgust triggers. Robots clean sewage. Machines process dead bodies.

discovery.text: As physical disgust triggers disappear, moral disgust is expanding into new territories—online shaming grows.

twist.text: Virtual reality may teach disgust tolerance. Controlled digital exposure could rewire the reflex at scale.

climax.text: The core question remains: can we keep disgust's disease protection while losing its social cruelty?

punchline.text: The future of disgust is learning which 'yucks' to keep.

quiz.question: What is expanding as physical disgust triggers decrease?
